meta.name: Send a daily RSS digest email with GPT-4o-mini and SMTP

name: Multi-Feed RSS Digest with Keyword Filtering and Priority Routing

parameters.content:
## Multi-Feed RSS Digest with Keyword Filtering & Priority Routing
Pulls every feed you list, filters out noise by keyword, flags the items you actually care about, and emails one digest that leads with what matters. Sends nothing on a quiet day.

## How it works
1. Runs on a schedule, or on demand from the manual trigger
2. Reads every feed in your config - one dead feed does not stop the others
3. Filters items: drops duplicates, anything outside your time window, anything matching your exclude keywords, and anything that fails your include keywords
4. Flags remaining items that hit your priority keywords
5. If nothing survived, it stops. Otherwise AI writes a digest leading with the priority items, and emails it.

## Setup
- [ ] Connect OpenAI credentials in OpenAI Chat Model
- [ ] Connect SMTP credentials in Send Digest Email
- [ ] Open Digest Config and set your feeds, keywords, time window, and the from/to addresses
- [ ] Adjust the schedule if 7am is not when you want it

## Customize
All behaviour lives in Digest Config:
- **IncludeKeywords** - leave blank to keep everything, or list terms an item must match
- **ExcludeKeywords** - drop anything mentioning these
- **PriorityKeywords** - these get led with in the email
- **LookbackHours** - how far back to consider an item new

## 1. Sources & Filtering
Two ways in - scheduled or on demand. Every feed is read independently, then one filter pass handles dedupe, time window, exclude/include keywords, and priority flagging.

## 2. Summarize & Deliver
Nothing survived the filter? The run stops here instead of emailing you an empty digest. Otherwise the AI leads with priority items and the email goes out with a filter summary at the bottom.

assignments.name: ExcludeKeywords
assignments.value: sponsored, advertisement, deal of the day

parameters.text:
=Write today's news digest email body from the items below.

HIGH PRIORITY - these matched the priority keywords, lead with them:
{{ $json.priorityText }}

EVERYTHING ELSE:
{{ $json.standardText }}

Rules:
- Start with the high priority items under a "Worth your attention" heading. If there are none, skip that section entirely.
- Then the rest under "Also today", grouped by theme where items overlap.
- One or two sentences per item, plain language, no hype.
- Include each item's link.
- Never invent an item that is not listed above.

Plain text, ready to paste into an email body.
